title: python-basic: phantom drivers must not fire
description: Scanner emits asset:aiosqlite, asset:asyncpg, and asset:pymysql on python-basic/app.py when only psycopg2 is imported. These are false positives; the drivers share 'connect' as a callName and psycopg2.connect triggers them. Tracked by bug KDATAP-0f7953.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Verified against live scan output. Negative expectation confirmed. Linked bug tracks the fix.
